title: Ingo Swann affects a thermistor in a Faraday cage

tellings.quote: they put a thermister inside of a fad cage and then inosan was able to affect that with his mind

related.note: The same early-1970s SRI test of Swann affecting a shielded device with Puthoff, but here the device is a thermistor in a Faraday cage rather than a shielded quark detector.

plain: In California in the early 1970s, researchers are said to have put a thermistor, a small temperature sensor, inside a Faraday cage, a metal enclosure that blocks outside electrical signals, and a psychic named Ingo Swann then changed its readings with his mind. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode with Joe McMoneagle, naming the physicists Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ as part of the work. If true, it would mean a mind could act on a shielded instrument with no physical link.
